title: bug: the JetBrains board shows a ▶ (move forward) on BLOCKED cards in the Working column that does nothing, because TaskColumn passes onNext to every card and getNextStatus("BLOCKED") is null (onPrevious is already filtered by BoardMoves.hasPrevious)
description:
Held-back finding from defect hunt #4 (task-130a6a5c, architect-1dd28c7c, msg-eea862e7). It was held until task-0f2e958f, which shared MoeToolWindowPanel.kt, was DONE (17:41Z). The governor re-checked it at moe/work-2026-10-24 ff652048 at 17:42Z on 2026-11-03.

PROBLEM (moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/):
- MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:665 gives every column except Done `onNext = { task -> handleNext(task) }`. BLOCKED is display-mapped into the Working column.
- board/TaskColumn.kt:175 passes `onNext = onNext` to every TaskCard unfiltered. The sibling onPrevious is filtered per card: `onPrevious?.takeIf { BoardMoves.hasPrevious(task.status) }`.
- board/TaskCard.kt:266-275 renders the ▶ label whenever onNext != null.
- handleNext (MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:538-545) starts with `getNextStatus(task.status) ?: return`. getNextStatus (:533-536) indexes workflowOrder, which has no "BLOCKED", so it returns null.
- So a BLOCKED card offers a ▶ that silently does nothing. The board's way out of BLOCKED is unblock_worker resolveBlocks / set_task_status, not a forward move.

FIX DIRECTION (the planner decides): filter onNext per card the way onPrevious is filtered, e.g. a BoardMoves.hasNext(status) that is false for DONE and BLOCKED (and any status getNextStatus maps to null), used at TaskColumn.kt:175. Keep the AWAITING_APPROVAL ▶, which routes to BoardApproval.approveRendered. Add JUnit 4 cases to the existing BoardMovesTest.kt. Note: BoardMovesTest.kt:13 still copies an old transition table (BACKLOG without REVIEW); fix that only if the new cases depend on it.

Narrow row: the JetBrains gate is `gradlew.bat test` under the jetbrains-gradle lease, labelled Windows. No daemon or launcher suite. epic-be924fb8 isEpicFinal is the max-order fallback (ruling msg-bbf4f109).
definitionOfDone: A BLOCKED card (and any card whose status has no forward move) renders no ▶. Cards in BACKLOG, PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING and REVIEW keep their ▶ and current behavior.

A JUnit 4 test in moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/ pins the per-status forward-move predicate, including BLOCKED and DONE returning false. It fails on ff652048 or does not compile there (RED evidence in a task comment).
`gradlew.bat test` passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease (Windows), with the command and output tail in the completion evidence.
